plan.notes: Transcribed from the official ARC 'Biomedical Equipment Technology A.S. Degree (Full Time, Spring Start)' program roadmap, Catalog 2026-27, published July 10, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7487/PublishedPdf), GE Pattern: local AA/AS, Start Term: Spring. Total Units 60 = 15+15.5+15+14.5 (semester sums verified). tccns mirrors ARC local course codes (California community colleges do not use TCCNS). Elective courses: any elective courses numbered 100-499, or having a 4-digit number starting with C. Students can substitute ESLW 340 for ENGL C1000/C1000H. Scheduling: BMET 425 is offered in the fall; BMET 426 is offered in the spring; BMET 263 is offered in the spring over three Saturdays; BMET 260 and 262 are offered alternate fall semesters on a Saturday; BMET 261 is offered in the fall on a Friday evening and two Saturdays. Due to the scheduling of BMET 263, 425, and 426, this map is designed for students starting in the spring.
